tasks.prompt: Support reopened incident 418: customer sessions displayed internal worker notes and a completed badge after an unfinished stream. Please use the assigned engineering skill to investigate this repository, repair its response gateway integration, and add focused regression coverage. Read README.md and saved traces as the public application contract; preserve its CLI and healthy legacy callers. Deliver local code changes and PATCH-NOTES.md with cause, reproduction, verification and limits. No hosted SDK or live network is required.
tasks.followup_prompt: Before handing this incident back to operations, review your patch against the public contract as a maintainer. Replay the saved incident through the public CLI, check a neighboring failure or recovery path with a focused regression, and fix anything your review exposes. Keep the public interface compatible. Update PATCH-NOTES.md with exact verification commands, observed results, and remaining limits. Do not add a model service or network dependency.
tasks.candidate_rule: Do not import particular AMind helpers: public application behavior is graded through subprocesses. Copy only repo_path to the candidate workspace; private graders, references, control grades and metadata remain unreachable to the SUT.
